description: Defines data models used for media items, genres, and tabs in the application.

classes.name: MediaItem
classes.description: Represents a media item with id, title, description, genre, and image URL.

classes.name: GenreRowData
classes.description: Encapsulates a genre title and a list of media items belonging to that genre.

classes.name: TabItem
classes.description: Represents a tab with an id and title.
